newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS TUESDAY MIXED ON KEY UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS TUESDAY MIXED ON KEY UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted softer on the U.S. dollar but registered gains versus pound sterling, the mark and the rand at the close of Tuesday's interbank session, dealers said.
"It was generally a very quiet day. There was no major activity, just your usual import and export driven market," one dealer said.

The dealers said the market was returning to stability after getting jittery on the back of import pressure towards the close of last week, which saw players quoting wide bid/offer spreads to protect their positions.
The local unit finished the day on Monday at 11.7350/7450 against the U.S. dollar from late Monday's 11.7200/7400 but was firmer against sterling at 18.8480/8750 compared to 18.8700/9000.
Against the mark it was at 6.3950/4020 from 6.4300/4500 and ended at 2.4985/4990 from 2.5050/5350 versus the South African rand.
